Types

CipherSuite = enum
  csAesGcm128 = 51, csAesGcm256 = 52, csAesCcm128 = 53, csChacha20Poly1305 = 54,
  csSm4Gcm = 55, csSm4Ccm = 56, csAriaGcm128 = 57, csAriaGcm256 = 58
KeyMaterial = object
  version*: TlsVersion
  cipher*: CipherSuite
  key*: seq[byte]
  iv*: seq[byte]
  salt*: seq[byte]
  recSeq*: array[8, byte] ## Record sequence number (big-endian on the wire). Starts at zero
                          ## for a fresh epoch and increments per record; for TLS 1.3
                          ## KeyUpdate re-arming, carry over the next expected sequence.
Validated key material for one direction. Build with initKeyMaterial, install with session.setTx/session.setRx. 
TlsVersion = enum
  tv12 = 771,               ## TLS 1.2 (`0x0303`).
  tv13 = 772                 ## TLS 1.3 (`0x0304`).

    ...raises: [KtlsError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Build validated KeyMaterial, raising KtlsError on length mismatch. The kernel additionally requires ARIA suites to use TLS 1.2 (enforced here so the failure surfaces before any syscall).
